## Quest Definition of Done (content PRs)

- [ ] Frontmatter valid, prerequisites exist, estimated time set
- [ ] L1-L5 present (or justified `skipTiers`); Core Fundamentals and Core Complexity written
- [ ] At least 4 primary sources in `sources.yml` with `verifiedOn`; no copied text; quotes under 15 words
- [ ] Every challenge: starter fails, solution passes
- [ ] Quiz >= 12, cards >= 15, interview questions >= 8, common mistakes >= 5
- [ ] Mini-game defined (or justified reuse) with an accessible alternative
- [ ] Boss defined and passable
- [ ] Claims reviewed against sources; unverified items marked `TODO-VERIFY`
- [ ] `pnpm verify` is green

## Code PRs

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pnpm verify` is green
